title: describe_niagara_catalog specification
description: specification payload for action=describe_niagara_catalog (Niagara domain, WS-07). Read-only, no target required. Returns UEREMCP's OWN accepted authoring vocabulary for create_niagara_effect and submit_niagara_graph: the primitive_id values this plugin's resolver accepts and the module asset each maps to, plus supported renderer hints, script usages and stack-input value modes. These exist only in this plugin, so no Epic toolset can report them. This is NOT a browse of Niagara's module library — Epic NiagaraToolset_Assets.FindNiagaraScripts searches every UNiagaraScript and is better for that; modules[].asset_path here is a curated shortlist, and unlisted /Niagara/Modules/ paths remain usable via a module's asset_path. Per-module input names are deliberately not returned: Epic NiagaraToolset_System.GetModuleSchemaFromAsset already returns them standalone.

search.description: Case-insensitive substring matched against primitive_id and module asset path. Omit to return the whole catalog.

verify_assets.description: Load each module script and report modules[].resolves, so a stale table row is caught before it is authored against. Set false for a cheaper name-only listing.
